milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The player must walk forward toward the cobblestone building and get close to the iron bars window in the front wall at spawn-relative [0, 2, 6]. max_distance=5 prevents auto-triggering at spawn (player starts ~6.3 blocks away), requiring at least 1-2 blocks of forward movement. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the iron bars.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The player must navigate around the cobblestone building to locate the campfire behind it at spawn-relative [0, 1, 9]. The building (walls at Z+6 and Z+7) physically blocks direct line-of-sight and walking path from spawn, requiring the player to walk around either side. max_distance=8 ensures the player has navigated close enough (spawn is ~9.06 blocks away, so won't auto-trigger). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the campfire.
